question: Did the Sydney Metro City & Southwest opening change evening travel from the centres on the new line?
measure: Mean weekday tap-ons, 3pm-7pm, per centre per week (log). Clean weekdays only; a week needs 3+.

data.source: TfNSW Opal Tap Data via the Commute Pulse pipeline (github.com/dylannnnn111/commute-pulse, out/daily_evening_tapons.csv)

new_stations.label: Centres with new metro stations (CBD, North Sydney)

line_extended.label: On the line, no new station (Chatswood, Macquarie Park)
